subject: Cloud Summit London — demo time mismatch from conference app
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@cloudworks.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: conference@cloudsummit.org
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Redwood demo slot at Cloud Summit — quick timezone question

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for offering a live demo while we're at Cloud Summit next week. The conference app shows your session as '09:00' and my profile timezone is set to Pacific, so I think that put the invite on my calendar as 01:00 PDT. Oops.

Could you confirm: are you planning to run at 09:00 BST (UK local) on Oct 7 or was that 09:00 in Redwood's internal PST? I want to send the invite to a couple of folks on my side but don't want them to join in the middle of the night.

Appreciate the quick clarity — we're excited to see the latency demo.

Best,
Emily
Emily Zhao
Senior Cloud Architect, CloudWorks
emily.zhao@cloudworks.io
+44 20 7946 0123

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@cloudworks.io>
Cc: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Redwood demo slot at Cloud Summit — quick timezone question

Hi Emily — thanks for flagging this. Short answer: it's 09:00 BST (London local) on Oct 7.

We initially created the invite in our scheduler with the organizer set to PDT which caused the app to convert it to attendees' perceived local time. That created the 01:00 PDT display in your calendar. Sorry for the confusion.

I'll resend an invite explicitly labeled "09:00 BST / 04:00 EDT / 01:00 PDT" and include the conference room and the booth Zoom fallback. Sergio, Hannah — can one of you attach the latest deck and a screenshot of the invite as you'll send it?

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 10:18:00 +0100
Subject: Updated invite: Redwood demo — 09:00 BST (Oct 7) — calendar screenshot attached

Hi Emily —

I've reissued the calendar invite and set the organizer to "Cloud Summit — Redwood Booth" (so it displays as local time for attendees). The invite body includes explicit times: 09:00 BST / 04:00 EDT / 01:00 PDT and the fallback Zoom link. I've attached a screenshot (calendar-screenshot.png) showing the cross‑timezone labels.

Also note: Cloud Summit's mobile app has a bug where it honors the attendee's profile timezone when showing session times rather than the session's published timezone. We're going to add a note in the invite and in the booth copy to reduce confusion.

Please confirm you received the new invite and that the time looks correct on your side.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

On Tue, 6 Oct 2026 at 10:18 AM BST Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:
> I've reissued the calendar invite and set the organizer to "Cloud Summit — Redwood Booth" ...

Thanks Hannah — received and the invite now shows 09:00 on Oct 7 in my calendar (BST). The cross‑timezone text is clear and the fallback Zoom is great. I'll forward internally to our product team and confirm a couple of folks who will join in‑person at the booth.

Two tiny asks: could you add an explicit note in the invite subject like "(09:00 BST — UK local)" and add the booth location (Hall 3, Stand B14)? That helps people at the venue find us quickly.

Emily

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, conference@cloudsummit.org

Subject: Re: Updated invite: Redwood demo — 09:00 BST (Oct 7) — final confirmation

Emily — thanks for the catch and the subject suggestion. I've updated the invite subject to: "Redwood demo (09:00 BST — UK local) — Hall 3, Stand B14" and added the booth location in the body. Conference organizers (cc'd) — can you confirm there's no competing session listed at Hall 3, Stand B14 at that time?

We'll see you on Oct 7 at 09:00 BST. We'll run the live latency demo at the booth and have the Zoom fallback ready if Wi‑Fi acts up.

Cheers,
Vanessa
